name: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS Specter IFF-9 Combat Eye
description:
The Specter IFF-9 is a full-replacement combat ocular unit integrating real-time Identify Friend/Foe tagging, ballistic trajectory prediction overlays, and threat-priority ranking across up to 24 simultaneous targets. It operates via a dedicated co-processor embedded behind the orbital socket, pulling environmental data through a mesh of LIDAR micro-emitters ringing the synthetic iris. Refresh rate is 240Hz with sub-10ms neural handoff latency, designed to keep pace with augmented reflex systems.

The IFF-9 is standard-issue for Arcturus private security contractors operating in the GLMZ industrial belts and is occasionally found on ex-military operators who kept their kit when they mustered out. On the street, a pair of Specter-Nines marks someone as either deeply connected to corporate muscle or dangerously willing to be noticed — the red targeting reticle that bleeds into the sclera during active threat-lock is hard to hide.
installation_requirements: Full ocular extraction, dedicated co-processor socket behind orbital plate, certified Arcturus-licensed surgeon
rejection_risk: Moderate — titanium orbital housing minimizes tissue rejection but co-processor implant requires secondary immune suppression protocol
maintenance: Quarterly firmware sync via Arcturus secure uplink; annual co-processor inspection; lens array cleaning every 6 weeks
specifications: {"resolution": "22K equivalent synthetic", "IFF_range": "400m active, 1.2km passive", "target_tracking": "24 simultaneous", "trajectory_prediction": "ballistic and kinetic, 0.8s lookahead", "refresh_rate": "240Hz", "low_light": "full-spectrum amplification to 0.001 lux", "thermal": "integrated passive thermal overlay", "power": "bioelectric cell, 72hr active combat draw", "neural_latency": "<10ms"}
side_effects: Persistent threat-tagging of civilians in crowded environments — chronic anxiety, hypervigilance
Scleral bleed-red during active lock; socially conspicuous and legally incriminating
Occasional false-positive IFF cascades causing nausea and disorientation
Long-term users report difficulty reading non-hostile social cues — emotional flattening
cultural_context: Specter-Nines are the open secret of GLMZ's corporate security ecosystem — technically Military-Only, practically available to anyone Arcturus wants armed. Seeing a pair on someone in a the Gray Zone-level bar means either stolen kit or someone's paying for protection. Either way, the room tends to clear.
known_users: Arcturus contract soldiers and CorpSec operators
Ex-military personnel who retained their hardware
Tier 4-5 executives with private security clearance
story_hooks: A Specter IFF-9 unit surfaces in a the Gray Zone pawnshop — still registered to an Arcturus operator listed as KIA six months ago
A player's IFF-9 begins tagging a specific civilian as a high-priority threat with no explainable data source — someone has written a ghost into the firmware
Arcturus issues a mandatory remote-wipe notice for all IFF-9 units; operators who comply lose their sight for 72 hours while replacements are 'processed'
